name: model_b_github
notes: Model B on the GitHub real-chip thermal-map dataset (data/github_real, data/generated_github). die_L_x_m is set to 1.0 (abstract unit square) since no physical die size is known for these parts. Rather than invent new physical units, t_die/h_eff are chosen so eps = t_die/(h_eff*L^2) matches the synthetic-dataset calibration (~5.55e-4): what matters for the PDE is the ratio of lateral conduction to vertical sinking, not absolute metres. leak_fraction is set to 0 (no basis for a per-block leakage fraction on real, floorplan-unknown chips) -- a further simplification beyond the synthetic config's already-approximate mean leak_fraction. k(T) keeps the synthetic generator's k_A/k_offset, a generic silicon conductivity law, not something uniquely calibrated to the 12mm geometry.
